rationale: Record retry handling in tools/scripts/fetch_skia_for_release.py, the fetcher that downloads the pinned Skia release asset. A transient 5xx, 429 or dropped connection used to abort the fetch on the first attempt; the script now retries 408/425/429/5xx and the transient URLError/TimeoutError/ConnectionError/IncompleteRead family over four attempts with 2s to 30s backoff, honouring a numeric Retry-After, and still raises 403/404 immediately because those mean the pin names a missing asset. The pinned revision, the asset it resolves to, the bytes it writes and the layout it unpacks are all unchanged, so no Skia backend, no render surface and no captured output moves. The accompanying edits are the test registration of tools/scripts/test_fetch_skia_for_release_extra.py in workflow-lint, three SKILL.md notes, and a regenerated GPU handoff ledger plus receipt. This touches no accepted expansion boundary and no Vellum source authority, so the disposition is watch-only.
